metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: 2.0×ATR SL and 3.5×ATR TP on H1 bars with 3-bar (3 hour) horizon. M5→H1 compression ratio is 12×; original M5 horizon=12 bars, scaled 12/12=1, conservative round-up to 3. SL/TP multipliers kept same as M5 (2.0/3.5) for primary barrier strategy line consistency. 1.75:1 RR.
metadata.design_notes: H1 variant for Survival barrier strategy. 3-bar horizon = 3h. Same SL/TP multipliers as M5 SUR contract. H1 features already present in v9_institutional_40 schema (8 H1-specific features). Sparse data constraint: H1 has ~15k bars vs M5's ~37k; fewer training samples expected.
